mainEntity.name: Q: What is the most important rule in street photography?

acceptedAnswer.text: A: The paramount rule in street photography is to ensure all photos are candid. This means you should not interact with your subjects before, capturing the photo. Additionally, remember to say thank you and share the photo with the subject if they notice you taking it.
